languageModelTools.name: mssql_list_databases
languageModelTools.userDescription: List SQL Server connections and databases connected in MS SQL Manager.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the Microsoft SQL Server connections and databases that are currently connected in the MS SQL Manager extension, with their connectionId and database values and which one is current. Use it when the user did not say which database to work with or refers to a database/server by name. Pass the returned connectionId and database to mssql_get_schema, mssql_run_query and mssql_open_query.

languageModelTools.name: mssql_get_schema
languageModelTools.userDescription: Give Copilot the schema and database instructions of a connected SQL Server database.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the schema of a Microsoft SQL Server database connected in MS SQL Manager: tables (columns, data types, primary/foreign keys, indexes, row counts), views, stored procedures and functions, the server version/compatibility level, and the user's database-specific instructions (business rules, naming conventions). ALWAYS call this before writing, explaining or optimizing a SQL query for the user's database, and use only objects it returns — never guess table or column names. Follow the returned database instructions. If the target database is ambiguous the user is asked to pick one. For large databases pass 'objects' to get only the tables you need.

connectionId.description: Connection id (or connection name) from mssql_list_databases or a previous tool result. Omit to infer it.

database.description: Database name. Omit to infer it from the connection, the active SQL editor or previous calls.

objects.description: Optional object names to include, e.g. ['dbo.Orders', 'Customer*']. Omit for the whole schema.

languageModelTools.name: mssql_run_query
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run a T-SQL query on a connected SQL Server database and return the results to Copilot.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Executes T-SQL against a Microsoft SQL Server database connected in MS SQL Manager and returns every result set as JSON (limited to maxRows rows each) or the number of affected rows. Use it to look at data, verify assumptions or answer questions about the data. Call mssql_get_schema first so the query only uses existing objects. Batch several independent SELECTs in one call when possible. For INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL explain the impact and get the user's consent before calling. Reuse the connectionId and database returned in earlier results.

connectionId.description: Connection id (or connection name). Omit to infer it.

database.description: Database name. Omit to infer it.

maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows returned per result set (default 100, max 1000).

languageModelTools.name: mssql_open_query
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open a T-SQL query in the MS SQL Manager SQL editor (optionally executing it).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Opens a T-SQL query in a new MS SQL Manager SQL editor tab bound to the target connection and database, optionally executing it so the user sees the results grid. Use it when the user wants the query in the editor or wants to see the full result set themselves.

connectionId.description: Connection id (or connection name). Omit to infer it.

database.description: Database name. Omit to infer it.

execute.description: Execute the query right after opening it. Defaults to false.

mssqlManager.showTableStatistics.description: Show row count and size information for tables in the database explorer tree.

mssqlManager.queryTimeout.description: Query execution timeout in seconds. Set to 0 for no timeout (infinite).

mssqlManager.immediateActive.description: Activate extension immediately when VS Code starts. When false, extension activates only when SQL files are opened.

mssqlManager.colorPrimaryForeignKeys.description: Color primary key columns (gold) and foreign key columns (blue) in query results.

mssqlManager.aiInlineCompletions.enabled.description: Show AI inline (ghost text) suggestions in the SQL editor using GitHub Copilot language models. Also respects the 'github.copilot.enable' setting for SQL.

mssqlManager.variableHighlightColor.description: Color used to highlight SQL variables (e.g. @MyVar) in the SQL editor. Set to empty string to disable.

mssqlManager.cteHighlightColor.description: Color used to highlight CTE names in the SQL editor. Set to empty string to disable.

mssqlManager.jsonXmlHighlightColor.description: Color used for JSON/XML values in query result cells.

enumDescriptions: Single view — all result sets displayed stacked in the results tab.
Separately — each result set shown on its own tab (Set 1, Set 2, ...).
mssqlManager.multipleResultSetsDisplay.description: Controls how multiple result sets are displayed in the query results panel.

enumDescriptions: Plain — no formatting, values displayed as-is (e.g. 1234567.89)
2 decimal places — locale separators, always 2 decimal digits (e.g. 1,234,567.89)
4 decimal places — locale separators, always 4 decimal digits (e.g. 1,234,567.8900)
mssqlManager.numberFormat.description: Controls how numeric values are displayed in query results.

mssqlManager.schemaCacheValiditySeconds.description: Duration in seconds to cache database schema hash validation results. Longer values reduce database queries but may delay detection of schema changes. (Default: 120 seconds)

mssqlManager.queryHistorySaveOnlyUnique.description: When enabled, executing the same query on the same connection updates the existing history entry instead of creating a duplicate. Different connections always create separate entries.

mssqlManager.formatting.tabWidth.description: Number of spaces used for SQL indentation.

mssqlManager.formatting.linesBetweenQuer.description: Formatting: blank lines between SQL statements.

mssqlManager.formatting.indentStyle.description: Formatting: indentation style for SQL formatting.

mssqlManager.formatting.logicalOperatorN.description: Formatting: place AND/OR before or after line breaks.

mssqlManager.formatting.formatBeforeRun.description: Formatting: automatically format query before execution.

mssqlManager.dmlProtection.warnOnMissing.description: Show a confirmation dialog before executing UPDATE or DELETE statements that do not contain a WHERE clause.

mssqlManager.dmlProtection.limitAffected.description: Before executing UPDATE or DELETE, run the statement in a rolled-back transaction to check the number of affected rows. If the count exceeds the safe threshold, a confirmation dialog is shown.

mssqlManager.mcp.enabled.markdownDescription: Run a local MCP server (Streamable HTTP on `127.0.0.1`, bearer-token protected) exposing the `list_databases`, `get_schema` and `run_query` tools, so any MCP client (Claude, Cursor, Copilot CLI, ...) can use the connections opened in MS SQL Manager. Use **MS SQL Manager: Copy MCP Server Configuration** to get the client configuration. Inside VS Code, Copilot uses the built-in `#mssqlSchema` / `#mssqlQuery` tools instead.

mssqlManager.mcp.port.description: Port of the local MCP server (bound to 127.0.0.1 only).

mssqlManager.dmlProtection.maxAffectedRo.description: Maximum number of affected rows allowed without confirmation when DML row-limit protection is enabled.
